sentences.en: On Thursday, the two presumptive nominees for president, Joe Biden and Donald Trump, traveled to Texas where they gave dueling speeches

sentences.en: I mean, how did we go from Biden avoiding this immigration issue like the plague to kind of tiptoeing into it to now trying to use it as a cudgel against Trump?
sentences.zh: 我是说，拜登从一开始对移民问题避之不及，到后来小心翼翼地试探，再到现在试图将其作为攻击特朗普的武器，这中间经历了什么？

sentences.en: I mean, to understand this, you really have to go back to Biden's 2020 campaign.
sentences.zh: 要理解这一点，真的得回溯到拜登的2020年竞选活动。

sentences.en: We believe in freedom of religion.
sentences.zh: 我们信仰宗教自由。

sentences.en: That's why we'll end the Muslim ban.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们要结束穆斯林禁令。

sentences.en: This was, of course, after the anti-immigration agenda that President Trump implemented that included a travel ban against Muslim-majority countries.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是在特朗普总统实施了包括针对穆斯林占多数国家的旅行禁令在内的反移民议程之后。

sentences.en: They got separated from their parents, and it makes us a laughingstock and violates every notion of who we are as a nation.
sentences.zh: 他们与父母分离，这让我们沦为笑柄，也违背了我们作为一个国家所代表的一切理念。

sentences.en: And that included extreme policies at the border, such as family separation that Democrats spent their time during the 2020 campaign condemning.
sentences.zh: 这其中就包括边境上的极端政策，比如民主党在2020年竞选期间花费大量时间谴责的骨肉分离政策。

sentences.en: So, of course, coming into office, you had Democrats using language that was much more pro-immigration.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，在上任之初，民主党人使用的语言要亲移民得多。

sentences.en: Within 100 days, I'm going to send to the United States Congress a pathway to citizenship for over 11 million undocumented people.
sentences.zh: 在100天内，我将向美国国会提交一份法案，为超过1100万无证移民提供入籍途径。

sentences.en: You heard the president pledge to restore humanity, order, compassion to the immigration system.
sentences.zh: 你听到了总统承诺要恢复移民系统的仁慈、秩序和同情心。

sentences.en: And those who come seeking asylum, we should immediately have the capacity to absorb them, keep them safe until they can be heard.
sentences.zh: 对于那些寻求庇护的人，我们应该立即具备接纳他们的能力，在他们的申请得到审理前确保他们的安全。

sentences.en: But practically on the ground, there were some Trump-bearer policies that did stay in place.
sentences.zh: 但在实际操作层面，确实有一些特朗普时期的政策被保留了下来。

sentences.en: That included something known as Title 42.
sentences.zh: 其中包括所谓的“第42条”。

sentences.en: This was a pandemic emergency rule that essentially sealed the border to asylum seekers.
sentences.zh: 这是一项大流行时期的紧急规定，本质上封锁了边境，拒绝庇护申请者入境。

sentences.en: The administration also began to deport Haitian migrants back to Haiti as well.
sentences.zh: 政府还开始将海地移民驱逐回海地。

sentences.en: And there were photos of Border Patrol agents trying to keep migrants from entering into the country.
sentences.zh: 当时还有边境巡逻人员试图阻止移民进入美国的照片。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那件事。

sentences.en: So while rhetorically we were hearing often about compassion and humanity, on the ground, we were seeing once again a reliance on deterrence.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然我们在口头上经常听到关于同情心和人道主义的言论，但在实际行动中，我们再次看到了对威慑手段的依赖。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So during the campaign in 2020, he was kind of speaking the language of the left in large part as a reaction to the extreme policies that Trump had enacted.
sentences.zh: 所以在2020年竞选期间，他在很大程度上是在用左派的语言说话，作为对特朗普所实施的极端政策的一种反击。

sentences.en: But he quickly moderated.
sentences.zh: 但他很快就变得温和了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And even though some of those policies were in place, the number of crossings continued to grow.
sentences.zh: 尽管其中一些政策依然存在，但越境人数仍在持续增长。

sentences.en: Some of that's outside of the president's control.
sentences.zh: 其中一些因素超出了总统的控制范围。

sentences.en: I mean, in the wake of the pandemic, of climate change, of a global migration trend, as well as the perception that the election of President Biden would mean a more welcoming
sentences.zh: 我是说，在大流行、气候变化、全球移民趋势的影响下，再加上人们认为拜登总统的当选意味着对边境采取更欢迎的态度，

sentences.en: approach to the border, you had nationalities from all over the world attempting to cross into the United States.
sentences.zh: 来自世界各地的不同国籍的人都在试图越境进入美国。

sentences.en: And so as this problem continued to grow worse and crossings continued to surge, the pressure is really building on the White House.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着这个问题持续恶化，越境人数不断激增，白宫面临的压力确实越来越大。

sentences.en: Republicans relentlessly are asking President Biden when he's going to go to the border.
sentences.zh: 共和党人不断地质问拜登总统何时去边境看看。

sentences.en: I was actually with Vice President Kamala Harris when she traveled to Guatemala to address the root causes of migration.
sentences.zh: 我当时其实正陪同卡玛拉·哈里斯副总统前往危地马拉，去解决移民的根源问题。

sentences.en: And even there, she was being asked, why are you here and not at the U.S.-Mexico border?
sentences.zh: 即便是在那里，她也被问到：为什么你在这里，而不是在美国和墨西哥边境？

sentences.en: And initially, you know, those requests were dismissed by top White House officials as that's just going to be sort of political theater.
sentences.zh: 起初，你知道，这些要求被白宫高层官员驳回了，认为那不过是政治作秀。

sentences.en: But eventually, they did succumb to the pressure and each make a visit to the border.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他们还是屈服于压力，各自对边境进行了一次访问。

sentences.en: So Biden and Harris go to the border eventually, but there's a real reluctance to engage with this at all publicly.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登和哈里斯最终去了边境，但他们对公开处理此事表现出真正的抵触。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So Republicans at the time really did sense an opening.
sentences.zh: 所以当时的共和党人确实感觉到了一个突破口。

sentences.en: And in the spring of 2022, we have a pivotal moment that we all know well by now.
sentences.zh: 在2022年春天，我们经历了一个现在大家都非常熟悉的转折点。

sentences.en: This is when Texas Governor Greg Abbott starts to put vulnerable migrant families and bust them to cities led by Democrats.
sentences.zh: 当时德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特开始将弱势移民家庭送上巴士，运往由民主党人领导的城市。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This continues to escalate.
sentences.zh: 这种情况不断升级。

sentences.en: I remember getting a call one morning from a source who said that a bus of migrants had been dropped off in front of the vice president's residents as well.
sentences.zh: 我记得一天早上接到一个消息来源的电话，说一辆载有移民的巴士也被丢在了副总统官邸门前。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And, you know, and it is important to remember much of this was happening without giving a heads up to some of the organizations or officials in these cities.
sentences.zh: 而且，你要知道，必须记住的是，这一切发生时，很多时候都没有提前通知这些城市的组织或官员。

sentences.en: One result, though, is this only exacerbates a humanitarian crisis, but also a political crisis for the White House.
sentences.zh: 然而，一个结果是，这不仅加剧了人道主义危机，也给白宫造成了政治危机。

sentences.en: And it causes, of course, a crisis for these cities, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，这也给这些城市带来了危机，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, we've covered this in New York.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们在纽约报道过这件事。

sentences.en: Mayor Eric Adams and Governor Hochul, you know, are up in arMs.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·亚当斯市长和霍楚尔州长，你知道，他们都愤怒不已。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.zh: 所以现在民主党市长们表示，他们不仅担心自己的市政预算，

sentences.zh: 还担心随着越来越多的移民被送往这些城市，他们所面临的政治压力。

sentences.en: And as a result, many of those Democratic leaders turn that pressure back on the White
sentences.zh: 结果，许多民主党领导人将这种压力转嫁回白宫，

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: They're criticizing the Biden administration directly.

sentences.en: Like, it's not just Republican officials.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是共和党官员。

sentences.en: It's his own party coming after him for this.

sentences.en: And look, after a legal fight, Title 42 was lifted and the administration is scrambling for solutions to the border.

sentences.en: And then this interesting thing happens, which is that the issue of the border no longer just
sentences.zh: 然后发生了一件有趣的事，那就是边境问题不再仅仅影响移民政策和总统的国内议程，

sentences.en: impacts immigration and the president's domestic agenda, but also threatens to impact his foreign policy agenda.

sentences.en: Biden and the White House have seen rallying support for Ukraine as one of his crowning achievements.

sentences.zh: 而这正是他实现这一目标的机会。

sentences.en: So publicly, you would hear the White House at this point say, look, we need to pass this aid for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 所以公开场合，你会听到白宫此时说：看，我们需要通过这项对乌克兰的援助。

sentences.en: Lives are at stake overseas.
sentences.zh: 海外的生命危在旦夕。

sentences.zh: 白宫官员认为这是事实。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: This may be a way to enact some of the policies that maybe in closed door meetings we've discussed that we want, that we need.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一种方式，可以实施一些我们可能在闭门会议中讨论过、我们想要、我们需要但过去无法公开谈论的政策，

sentences.en: But in the past, couldn't speak about publicly because of the backlash you would get from immigration advocates and the progressive flank of the party.
sentences.zh: 因为那样会遭到移民倡导者和党内进步派的强烈反对。

sentences.en: But also, it could be a way for the president to say, look, Republicans, you guys have criticized me over this crisis throughout my presidency.
sentences.zh: 但这也是总统说“看，共和党人，你们在我整个总统任期内一直因为这场危机批评我”的一种方式。

sentences.en: Well, here's a solution.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这里有一个解决方案。

sentences.en: And it not only will be key for my foreign policy agenda, but it also is a way to actually implement some of the restrictions that have been so polarizing within the party in past
sentences.zh: 这不仅将成为我外交政策议程的关键，也是一种实际实施一些过去几年在党内极具争议的限制措施的方式。

sentences.en: years.
sentences.zh: 年。

sentences.en: But now is the time where we have an opportunity to implement some of those border restrictions.
sentences.zh: 但现在正是我们有机会实施其中一些边境限制措施的时候。

sentences.en: So Senate Democrats and Senate Republicans at this point are working out a bill that would
sentences.zh: 所以参议院民主党人和共和党人此时正在制定一项法案，

sentences.en: turn away many asylum seekers, make it harder to gain asylum while increasing resources at the border.
sentences.zh: 该法案将拒绝许多庇护申请者，增加获得庇护的难度，同时增加边境资源。

sentences.en: The White House is sort of behind Senate Democrats continuing to support that bill.
sentences.zh: 白宫在某种程度上支持参议院民主党人继续推动该法案。

sentences.en: And you're also seeing the president lean in a bit more into these negotiations.
sentences.zh: 你也能看到总统在这些谈判中投入了更多精力。

sentences.en: Towards the end of last year, while facing questions from reporters, there was a pivotal moment where he said, no, I am open to significant compromises at the border.
sentences.zh: 去年年底，在面对记者提问时，出现了一个关键时刻，他说：不，我对边境问题的重大妥协持开放态度。

sentences.en: Yeah, so this is the big shift, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这是一个巨大的转变，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, Biden is now seeing the immigration issue and he's endorsing some very, very restrictive
sentences.zh: 我是说，拜登现在看待移民问题的方式变了，他正在支持一些非常、非常严格的边境政策，

sentences.en: policies on the border, not as a concession he's willing to make, you know, just to get
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是他为了获得乌克兰资金而愿意做出的让步，

sentences.en: Ukraine funding.
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: He's actually seeing these very restrictive policies as good politics for him within his own party.
sentences.zh: 他实际上认为这些非常严格的政策对他党内来说是好的政治策略。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we continue to see the White House go even further in this direction.
sentences.zh: 我们继续看到白宫在这个方向上走得更远。

sentences.en: When the House Republicans sink this bill, taking a cue from former President Trump, who
sentences.zh: 当众议院共和党人否决了这项法案时，他们听从了前总统特朗普的暗示，

sentences.en: preferred that it be an issue to be used against the White House rather than a policy win for
sentences.zh: 特朗普更希望这是一个用来对付白宫的问题，而不是拜登总统的政策胜利。

sentences.en: President Biden.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到白宫继续加大力度。

sentences.en: He echoes the language once used by the Trump administration saying, look, if you had sent me this bill, I would shut down the border.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 这导致了今天的情况，你确实看到了他们试图采取这种进攻性策略。

sentences.en: But now you have President Biden going, using the border as a backdrop and saying, no longer will the Democratic Party be accused of not putting forward solutions to this crisis.

sentences.en: But actually, it's the Republicans that are neglecting what is one of the more pressing issues in this nation.

sentences.zh: 所以让我们推演一下。

sentences.en: Well, I think that you can expect him to continue to call Congress to do something about this.

sentences.en: actions that would essentially replicate some of what was being negotiated in that Senate bipartisan bill.

sentences.en: I mean, one thing that is certain about this shift, this strategy by the White House is it's going to put the spotlight on this crisis.

sentences.en: It's going to put the spotlight on this issue.

sentences.zh: 它将把聚光灯投向一个历史上共和党人一直希望获得更多关注的政策。

sentences.en: So look, the White House has been squeezed on the border and immigration since President
sentences.zh: 所以看，自拜登总统上任以来，白宫在边境和移民问题上一直受到挤压。

sentences.zh: 所以看，自拜登总统上任以来，白宫在边境和移民问题上一直受到挤压。

sentences.zh: 正因如此，这成了他目前面临的最令人沮丧的问题之一。

sentences.en: But then again, if, and it's a big if, of course, Biden is able to pull off that high wire act of turning this issue back on the Republicans and Trump specifically, it will
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，如果——当然，这是一个很大的假设——拜登能够成功完成那场高难度的走钢丝表演，将这个问题重新抛给共和党人，特别是特朗普，那么他将

sentences.en: This is all part of an effort to sort of do a course correction in a way and sort of meet Americans where they're at.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了在某种程度上纠正航向，并顺应美国民众的诉求。
